mapper.select: SELECT u.id,COALESCE(NULLIF(p.nickname,''),CONCAT('用户 ',u.id)) nickname FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1
SELECT id,code,name FROM community_tag WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY id
